CustomField.description: Fully qualified URL of an externally hosted banner image rendered across the top of the form. Use this when the banner is served from a CMS, static resource URL, or external host rather than referenced via Form Banner Image.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Paste the full https URL of the banner image to show at the top of the form (e.g. a hosted or static-resource link). Leave blank for no banner.
CustomField.label: Form Banner Image URL
